en.title: Opening an Archery Merchant Store
en.excerpt: Guide for archery shops, bowyers, and equipment dealers to activate a merchant store, configure seller profiles, and link bank payout accounts.
en.content:
Merchant Account Registration

Archeris Marketplace allows verified archery retailers and manufacturers to sell bows, arrows, targets, and tactical gear directly to the national archery community. Register as a Seller from your user profile menu to unlock the Seller Dashboard.

Store Profile & Business Information

Configure your storefront identity under Seller Dashboard > Settings > Store Profile:

  • Store Name & Slug: Unique store identity (e.g., archeris.net/store/nusantara-archery).
  • Banner & Avatar: High-resolution storefront banner showcasing your showroom or product lineup.
  • Origin City / District: Set your dispatch location to ensure accurate courier shipping calculations.

Connecting Payout Bank Accounts

Under Finance > Bank Accounts, add your business or personal bank account details (Bank Name, Account Number, Account Holder Name). All marketplace sales revenue will be disbursed to this verified account.

Shipping & Warranty Policies

Specify standard dispatch turnaround times (e.g., 24-48 hours), supported shipping couriers (JNE, SiCepat, J&T), and warranty terms for bows and sensitive carbon accessories.
